slot.brief: Give four words with subtle first-letter/second-letter differences; ask which word comes first (or third) as per dictionary order.

stem: In a library index, which of the following titles would be listed third when arranged in dictionary order?

verdicts.working: Compare letters after the shared prefix “bri”: a (briar), c (brick), n (bring), s (brisk). The third title is bring.

working:
All begin with “bri”. Compare the next letters: a (briar), c (brick), n (bring), s (brisk). Thus the order is briar, brick, bring, brisk; bring is third. The others are first, second and fourth, respectively.

Independent check: Compare letters after the shared prefix “bri”: a (briar), c (brick), n (bring), s (brisk). The third title is bring.
solution: All titles share the prefix “bri”. The next letters in alphabetical order are $a, c, n, s$, giving the order briar, brick, bring, brisk; hence the third title is bring.
